materials.prompt:
FRAME FORMAT: ONE 1024 × 512 pixel SPRITE SHEET containing exactly 8 opaque square frames in a 4-column × 2-row edge-to-edge grid. Every frame 256 × 256. Same scale and texture plane in every cell. No gutters, margins, grid lines or labels. Use case: stylized-concept; asset: looping flat liquid-background animation, PREVIEW CONCEPT ONLY.
Generate the same gorgeous orange/red/yellow LAVA material from the supplied approved volcanic map as an animated FLAT TOP-DOWN SURFACE. Only the liquid texture, no land, cliffs, islands, rocks, platforms, molten falls, horizon, perspective slope, eruption, flame sprites or objects. Dark red molten pools and thin bright yellow-orange interconnected fluid veins, crisp 16-bit pixel clusters and dark outlines. The whole frame is a horizontal material plane seen directly from above.
Across frames 1–8, the SAME vein topology gently flows/advects and expands/contracts with subtle interior orange light; stable total scale, no zoom or warping of the camera. Frame 8 returns close to frame 1 for a smooth loop. Each cell independently tiles on ALL FOUR edges, using a consistent complete molten pattern with no border. Avoid huge bright white blobs and excessive strobing. Quiet enough to sit beneath native projectiles.
No scene composition, no transparency, no terrain shore, text, numbers, arrows, watermark or UI. Exactly one full eight-frame animation sheet, not eight unrelated lava pictures.

FRAME FORMAT: single 1024 × 1024 opaque, seamless repeating flat texture. Use case: stylized-concept; asset: separate WATER BACKGROUND LAYER for the approved Bullets of Fury coastal/ice/city concepts.
A true 90-degree overhead FLAT deep-cobalt ocean/river surface, crisp authentic detailed 16-bit arcade pixel art. Long quiet dark blue/teal masses with small restrained pale-blue ripples and fine highlights, natural source-pixel wave clusters. No huge whitecaps, circular swirls, impact rings or glows that resemble attacks. The layer must tile on all four edges with no visible seam and will scroll independently beneath transparent shorelines. Uniform physical scale, no perspective, horizon or vertical walls. No shore, rocks, ice, foam border, islands, buildings, bridges, ships, people, vegetation, objects, labels, text, grid or watermark. Fill every pixel with water. Match the approved coastal city's cobalt/teal palette, not photorealistic water.

Authentic crisp 16-bit pixel art, dark contours, same material family as the reference's channels. No large asterisk-like rings or attack reticles. The texture is a horizontal liquid material seen directly from above, with no shore, walls, floor, platforms, pipes, drains, active discharges, objects, horizon, perspective, text, labels, borders or watermark.
